Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

- GIO (19), Section I, Appendix 5.  
- (j) General.1. Promotion to another post in the borrowing department will require prior concurrence of the parent department.
2. In the case of an employee getting pro forma promotion under 'Next Below Rule', his pay in the Pay Band will be fixed with reference to the pay of his immediate junior in the cadre of his service but he will draw the grade pay attached to his deputation post for the remaining period of deputation. - OM, dated 13-9-2008.
